name: FSF · utility subfab (lower)
contents: Dry pumps, scrubbers, chillers, chemical supply, transformers and distribution. The level that keeps contamination and heat sources away from the cleanroom

name: CSF · clean subfab (lower)
contents: Directly below the tools. RF generators and power racks, gas boxes and VMBs, pipe laterals. Return space through which air from the cleanroom passes

name: Lower cleanroom (FAB)
contents: Process tools, stockers, OHT. Tools on a raised access floor, FFUs in the ceiling. P1 has a visitor window corridor on 3F (press)

name: FFU plenum and truss (lower)
contents: Supply space that feeds air down to the FFUs. Make-up air units (MAU), DCC, structural trusses

name: FSF · utility subfab (upper)
contents: Pumps, scrubbers and chillers for the upper cleanroom; chemical and power distribution

name: CSF · clean subfab (upper)
contents: Power racks and gas boxes directly below the upper cleanroom

name: FFU plenum and roof truss (upper)
contents: Supply space for the upper cleanroom; MAU and DCC

name: Roof
contents: Exhaust scrubbers, fans and stacks; pipe racks. The perimeter band is higher than the central roof (drone video)
